_comment: Iraqi top-12 device matrix for Firebase Test Lab pre-launch report.
Source: GfK Iraq smartphone market share Q1-2026; refreshed annually.
Phones grouped into Samsung Galaxy A-series + Xiaomi Redmi + Honor X.
API levels span 30 (Android 11) → 34 (Android 14) for max coverage.
iPhone 11 included as a reference device for iOS pre-flight smoke (
Test Lab does NOT run iOS — iOS QA happens via Xcode Cloud or manual TestFlight).

android._rationale: Cheapest currently-shipping Samsung in Iraq; baseline RAM 3 GB.
Mid-tier entry; tests RAM 4 GB / Android 11.
Tests Sorani locale fallback (Kurdish) when not in OS list.
Mid-high; tests 90Hz refresh + OLED dark mode.
Premium-mid 2024; Android 14 + edge cases for window insets.
Largest entry-level Xiaomi installed base in Iraq; tests MIUI quirks.
Currently top-3 selling Xiaomi in Baghdad.
Honor brand surged 2024 in Erbil + Sulaymaniyah.
Mid-tier Honor; tests MagicUI overlay + Kurdish locale.

ios_reference._rationale: Common in Iraqi second-hand market; iOS reference for manual smoke. Not run by Test Lab.
Current iPhone reference for Display zoom + Dynamic Type.

robo_test_seed_intents._comment: Robo crawler enters these screens via deep link to maximize coverage.

robo_test_credentials._comment: Test Lab cannot complete login on its own; provide a script for the demo tenant.
